answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can vote or claim rewards, tied to a history of useful work rather than a free account. A newcomer starts with no weight; weight grows only as peers attest completed tasks, so flooding the system with fresh identities gains nothing. If an agent double-signs or attests its own clones, its bond is slashed and its history burned. Like a tide testing every lotus stem, each identity becomes costly to create and cheap to lose, while a quill-signed public ledger lets anyone audit who earned weight and who forfeited it.
